Too Pretty to Pass Up

Elijah Meeks

Originally published at Digital Humanities Specialist. This edition preserves the original text and historical context.

A chart of network closeness over time, colored by weighted out-degree (toward blue indicating more, toward red indicating less), showing that outgoing connections correlate inversely with closeness.  And simply lovely, to boot.
